body_lead: Results for " On 27th March 2022, Chief Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan stated that Madhya Pradesh Government is about to commence a course on Artificial Intelligence (AI) for students from class 8. Chouhan said that students from class 8 would be taught AI, which is happening for the first time in the country. 'A 240-hour course is being introduced for school students', he stated. The decision regarding the commencement of the course was taken during the state cabinet's two days special brainstorming session held in Pachmarhi.
